33:t_1:92.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Say hi to Mr. $$扇$$ for me too, just to be polite.」

33:t_1:94.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Well, then, $$シンジ$$... We're off to school.」

33:t_1:104.en:
$$マコト$$
「All hands, Level 1 battle stations. Surface-to-air interception units, stand ready!」

33:t_1:106.en:
$$シゲル$$
「It has broken through the Far East Branch's defense line and will reach $$第３新東京市$$ shortly.」

33:t_1:107.en:
$$冬月$$
「So the enemy's target is here...」

33:t_1:110.en:
$$リツコ$$
「The Dummy Plug swap for Unit-01 will be finished shortly.」

33:t_1:112.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
(The end of the myth... Do they, too, know what that means...?)

33:t_2:4.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Plug position can't be fixed! The Dummy System is rejecting the connection signal!」

33:t_2:6.en:
$$マヤ$$
「It's no good! The reset isn't working!」

33:t_2:7.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Keep going. Start over again from 308.」

33:t_2:8.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Why...? Why do you reject me... $$ユイ$$!」

33:t_2:11.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Let me... Let me...! Please let me ride this Unit-01!」

33:t_2:13.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Because I chose to do that... to fight in an EVA!」

33:t_2:15.en:
$$シンジ$$
「What I can do... is pilot an EVA... With that, I'll protect someone!」

33:t_2:16.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's... what I learned fighting with $c!」

33:t_2:18.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$ and $$真希波$$ are fighting desperately, too! I'll fight as well!」

33:t_2:19.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'm... the pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン初号機$$, $$碇シンジ$$!」

33:t_3:6.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
(I can't live anywhere but here anymore.)

33:t_3:8.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
(It's all right, $$碇$$. Even if I disappear, there are others who can take my place.)

33:t_3:9.en:
$$シンジ$$
「No! There's no one else like $$綾波$$!」

33:t_3:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's why I'm saving you now!!」

33:t_5:4.en:
$$シンジ$$
「$$綾波$$... Thank you, for what you did for Father...」

33:t_5:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I heard from $$ミサト$$. You invited Father to that dinner party that day, too, didn't you.」

33:t_5:6.en:
$$レイ#pt394$$
「I'm sorry. I couldn't do anything...」

33:t_5:7.en:
$$シンジ$$
「It's okay, now... This... is okay...」

33:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I apologize. There is an emergency under way at the moment, so today $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will be run by the automatic system.」

33:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The celebration for our ace pilots will also be postponed until next time.」

33:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh my... To be fated to get caught up in a $$時空震動$$... Bearing the $$烙印$$ is such a trial, isn't it.」

34:t_000:0.en:
$$シゲル$$
「All armor systems on the surface are damaged!」

34:t_000:1.en:
$$マコト$$
「$$サイデリアル$$ is coming!」

34:t_001:0.en:
$$マコト$$
「Who'd have thought they'd land in Japan and go after $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ first thing.」

34:t_001:1.en:
$$ミサト$$
($$ジェミニス$$ had this place marked too. Does $$サイデリアル$$ know what the EVAs mean...?)

34:t_001:2.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「What's the status of each EVA?」

34:t_001:3.en:
$$マヤ$$
「Unit-00 is ready to launch. Also, I'm told Unit-02's pilot will sortie as well.」

34:t_002:0.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Can you two hear me? The situation is as you can see.」

34:t_002:2.en:
$$マリ$$
「I can't believe they broke through $$第３新東京市$$'s defense system this easily.」

34:t_002:3.en:
$$ミサト$$
「You've been a big help, $$マリ$$. I'm glad you were in the $$ジオフロント$$.」

34:t_002:4.en:
$$マリ$$
「...I had a bit of a bad feeling. And then I finally visit $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ after all this time, and look at this.」

34:t_002:8.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Both of you, be careful. $$サイデリアル$$ has sent out a battleship...」

34:t_002:9.en:
$$ミサト$$
「A battleship is the center of command for enemy units and affects the entire battlefield. If possible, I'd like to take it out early, but...」

綾波.evidence: Shinji calls Rei by surname; same token already proposed in dlg_2005_00 (glossary 綾波レイ = Rei Ayanami)

真希波.evidence: Shinji names Mari by surname in 33:t_2:18, alongside Rei; glossary 真希波・マリ・イラストリアス = Mari Illustrious Makinami

kept_omissions: 33:t_1:106: Shigeru's subject (the approaching target) restored as 'It'; 33:t_1:112: 連中 kept as bare 'they' (Gendo's thought, referent not stated in scene)
uncertain: 34:t_002:5 ワンコ君 rendered 'Puppy' (Mari's nickname for Shinji; no glossary entry)
33:t_1:112 連中 = 'they' - probably Sidereal, possibly SEELE; left ambiguous
Unit-00/01/02, Dummy Plug/System, EVA, Angel written literally (no glossary tokens for 初号機/零号機/２号機; matches sibling dlg_2005_00)
Rei speaker uses $$レイ#pt394$$ (Ayanami, female) not Jigoku's #333; Rei's 碇君 = $$碇$$ as in dlg_2001_01
33:t_1:92 扇先生 = 'Mr. $$扇$$'; Shinji's 父さん = 'Father' to match dlg_2005_00
33:t_1:104 第一種戦闘配置 = 'Level 1 battle stations'; 33:t_1:105 目標は？ = 'Where's the target?' (asks enemy's position, answered by Shigeru)
33:t_2:9 乗せてください = 'Let me ride it!'; 33:t_3:9 綾波は綾波しかいない = 'no one else like Ayanami'
34:t_001:4 彼女 = Unit-02's pilot (Asuka, female per Fuyutsuki); Maya's line kept gender-neutral
